Hi Chloe,

We signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday and I wanted to get a short demo scheduled to make sure Redwood can meet our expectations before we start ramping. High-level context:
- Use case: in-product assistant + embeddings for search across customer support conversations.
- Expected volume: ~2M API calls/month initially, peaks ~600 requests/min during business hours.
- Timeline: pilot next month (Jan), likely production Q2 if pilot looks good.

I attached a small sample traffic export so you can see payload sizes and concurrency patterns (sample_traffic.csv).

Could we book a 30-min walkthrough next week? I'm in PST (San Francisco). Happy to share a couple slots or accept something on your side.

Thanks,
Mina Jansen

mina.jansen@orchardtech.com
(415) 555-0122

Hi Mina — great to meet you and thanks for the sample.

A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the session:
1) Are you planning to use streaming chat generation or request/response style (we can optimize routing differently).
2) Does your team need embeddings for semantic search only, or also for reranking/metadata join?
3) What latency SLO matters most for the assistant (p95 token latency target)?
4) Any SSO/SAML or data residency requirements for the pilot?

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Thu Dec 3, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu Dec 3, 2:00–2:30pm
- Fri Dec 4, 9:00–9:30am

Ben (cc'd) will lock the calendar once you confirm a slot. If none of those work, tell us two windows that fit your team and we'll swap.

I'll include a short tech lead from our side to cover throughput and batching recommendations.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
